li.label: Drank Nuka Cola
li.description: That Cola was so healthy! I'm feeling good now.

li.label: Drank Dark Cola
li.description: That Cola was so healthy! I am absolutely confident that you can defeat death in hand-to-hand combat.

li.label: Drank Quantum Cola
li.description: That Cola was so healthy! The taste is like a miniature supernova exploding, a mix of citrus madness and sweet radiation. Your taste buds scream in either delight or pain.

li.label: Swallowed radioactive blood
li.description: I swallowed a bag of radioactive blood. It may prolong my life, but the cost could be enormous, and it was absolutely disgusting.

li.label: ate wasteland, food
li.description: If I eat it and not the other way around, then I won.

li.label: ate FEV
li.description: If I eat it will be the last step.

li.label: Drank Scorponade
li.description: That Scorponade drink was so healthy! I'm feeling my heart is going to stop.

li.label: Finally, some fun!
li.description: Monsters from underground? A perfect opportunity for a good fight!

li.label: Atom Glow
li.description: Now I understand why no one lives in Glow. Although, wait a minute...

li.label: Glowing Brother
li.description: The doctors say it's "not good." But they haven't seen how beautifully I glow in the dark. Maybe they'll accept me into the Cult of Atom?

li.label: mild irradiation
li.description: I feel a slight tingling sensation... it's nice.

li.label: mild irradiation
li.description: Warmth spreads throughout my body. It's... calming.

li.label: moderate irradiation
li.description: My skin is glowing! Well, maybe not, but I feel good!

li.label: severe irradiation
li.description: I feel the power of the atom within me! This is magnificent!

li.label: extreme radiation
li.description: I MERGE WITH RADIATION! I AM THE GOD OF THE ATOM!

li.label: critical radiation
li.description: I... see light... so... beautiful...

li.label: trendy undertaker
li.description: This jacket smells like... opportunity. And slight decomposition. But mostly opportunity.

li.label: post-mortem collector
li.description: Two deadman's items! I'm like a walking memorial. Or a museum. Yes, I'm a fashion museum. With exclusive exhibits.

li.label: posthumous style icon
li.description: Three items! I'm literally wearing an entire graveyard of fashion. The living wear brands, the dead wear me. Or vice versa. Either way, it's a win-win!

li.label: lich lord of wardrobe
li.description: Four or more! I'm a necromancer of fashion! My outfits have history. And aroma. Mostly aroma. But who said history has to smell like roses? Roses were at funerals too.

li.label: strange glow
li.description: I saw plants glowing green and growing instantly. It was... beautiful? Or creepy? I'm confused about my feelings. And why do I taste pickles?

li.label: someone's breaking!
li.description: Ha-ha, look at this idiot! This is hilarious.

li.label: pleasant music
li.description: The radio is playing a pleasant melody. It lifts the mood. Funny how a few notes from a broken-down pre-war box can make the wasteland feel almost bearable.

li.label: divine music!
li.description: This melody is simply wonderful! {PAWN_nameDef} savors every note. For a brief moment, {PAWN_pronoun} forgets about the raiders, the radiation, and the fact that dinner might be two-hundred-year-old canned beans. Worth it.

li.label: irritating music
li.description: That awful screeching from the radio is driving {PAWN_objective} insane. Who even listens to this garbage? Probably the same people who think radroach is a delicacy. {PAWN_pronoun} would rather face a deathclaw than hear one more chorus.

li.label: Old World Blues
li.description: The voice on the radio... it spoke of hope amidst the ashes. For a moment, the wasteland didn't seem so bleak.

li.label: solar charge
li.description: The character is charged with solar energy!

li.label: strong spine
li.description: My back feels solid and reliable.

li.label: vigor charge
li.description: I feel energized and ready to go!
